decision.reason: The reviewed-import package builder successfully consumed exact external public-safe input with SHA-256 binding, produced a B-ranked needs-review candidate through the accepted five-rank classifier, preserved reviewed_import runner identity, and performed no network, canonical, public, or publication side effects. The system-level Acquisition Registry fallback field remains pending because current Registry granularity cannot express a detail-only reviewed-import operator path without also implying fallback semantics for the evidence-backed schedule route.
